title: Treaty of Chicago
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Chicago", at revision 1376051576, opens: "The Treaty of Chicago may refer to either of two treaties made and signed in the settlement that became Chicago, Illinois, between the United States and the Odawa, Ojibwe, and Bodéwadmi Native American peoples. The first was in 1821 and the second in 1833." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q928799, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 treaty between the United States and representatives of the Odawa, Ojibwe, and Potawatomi peoples". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
